title: dryopteris wallichiana
intro: Dryopteris wallichiana, commonly known as Himalayan Lady Fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris wallichiana include anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and hypotensive properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, high blood pressure, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
